腦波憂鬱症療效預測

EEG Research on Depression Treatment Response

學術研究合作 · 研究發表及門診使用

以治療前的額葉腦波，研究如何估計非侵入性腦刺激的反應。

建立專案需求 技術圖解

產業問題與工程挑戰

非侵入性腦刺激的治療反應因人而異，臨床團隊希望在治療前取得可供判讀的資訊。 腦波特徵與療效標註會受到資料群體和治療設定影響，模型需要在清楚定義的研究條件下評估。

技術方法與架構

實作與交付

由創辦人參與的學術研究，模型投入門診研究團隊常規使用。相關研究方法與結果刊於期刊。

成果

已發表跨資料集比較及驗證，研究模型亦有門診使用經驗。

  • 治療反應研究流程
  • 期刊發表與跨資料集比較

驗證與證據

論文定義的群體、比較條件與結果適用於該研究。門診使用狀態由研究團隊成員公開說明。

  • 期刊論文 · 跨資料集比較與驗證

Selected Work

EEG Research on Depression Treatment Response

Academic Research Collaboration · Published Research and Outpatient Use

Use pretreatment frontal EEG to study response to non-invasive brain stimulation.

繁體中文 Plan a project Technical diagram

Industry problem and engineering challenge

Response to non-invasive brain stimulation varies across patients. Clinical researchers wanted information they could review before treatment. EEG features and outcome definitions vary with the cohort and treatment setting. The model needs evaluation under clearly specified study conditions.

Technical approach and architecture

Implementation and deliverables

The founder contributed to the academic study, whose model entered routine use by the outpatient research team. The methods and results were published in a journal.

Outcome

The study published cross-dataset comparison and validation and has experience with outpatient use.

  • Treatment-response research workflow
  • Peer-reviewed results and cross-dataset comparison

Validation and evidence

The population, comparisons and results reported in the paper apply to that study. A member of the research team publicly documented outpatient use.

  • Journal paper · Cross-dataset comparison and validation
